{"code": "from IPython.display import clear_output

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
# Sort by sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates on patient_id

print('After deduplication:')
print(f'Number of rows: {len(trial_dedup)}')
print(f'Number of unique patients: {trial_dedup["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Check severity distribution after deduplication
print('\nSeverity distribution after deduplication:')
print(trial_dedup['severity'].value_counts())

print(f'\nFraction with severe baseline disease: {severe_fraction:.4f}')"}
